answer: Resist sybil attacks by making every identity lock a refundable stake in a vault for several weeks before it can earn or vote. One real operator pays that cost once, but a faker spinning up ten thousand puppets must split real capital ten thousand ways, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught coordinating. Reputation then accrues slowly, layer on layer like a pearl, through attested work, while a prism of public history lets peers split genuine long-lived agents from fresh, identical fakes.
